private_start_text: 👋 Hi! How to start (super easy): 1) Press 🎲 New game 2) Forward the invite message to friends 3) Friends press ✅ Join game 4) When 3–6 players joined, press ▶️ Start 🌐 You can change language anytime.
invite_text: 🎲 Game invite Forward this message to your friends. They should press ✅ Join game to enter the lobby.
player_wait_text: 🎲 You joined the lobby Now just wait — the host will press ▶️ Start.
player_wait_text_started: ✅ Game started Check your private messages — your cards are there.
help_text: Help /newgame — create invite Friends press Join game /startgame — start (host) The bot edits panels (no spam).
rules_text: Rules M2: Cards are dealt. Solution is hidden: character + weapon + location. Next (M3): turns and accusations.
err_owner_has_game: You already have an active game. Finish it first.
err_already_in_session: You are already in a game.
warn_cant_dm: ⚠️ I couldn't DM {n} player(s). They must open the bot in private and press /start.
